rubric_items.reason: All 15 known REQs (REQ-1 to REQ-15) are traced by at least one story; nothing is assumed or unknown.
Most stories carry one outcome. S-5 bundles the status label, the list filter and the dashboard constraint, but it is still small.

The ACs are Given/When/Then, and the 24h bracketing at 09:59/10:01 rules out end-time and end-of-day variants. REQ-11 is only checked on the list and the appointment page, not on the patient or doctor pages.
The 24h value comes from REQ-2/A-02, and the one-minute offsets are derived inline. Dates and times are example data, not limits.
Terms (Scheduled, Stale, Completed, No-show, Cancelled) match the glossary and intent and are used consistently.

findings.text: REQ-11 says Stale shows wherever an appointment status shows today. Appointment status also shows in AppointmentTable on the patient and doctor detail pages, but S-5 only checks the list and the appointment's own page.

cites.quote: wherever an appointment status is shown today
Given a Stale appointment, when staff open that appointment's own page, then its status shows Stale.

findings.suggested_fix: Add S-5 ACs checking that a Stale appointment shows Stale in the appointments section of the patient page and the doctor page.

findings.text: S-6's title describes a documentation change, not an outcome a user sees.

cites.quote: has not been marked Completed or `rescheduled` by 24h after its start time is marked Stale
